dispatches.message: MAJOR ORDER FAILED Insufficient materials have been harvested by the Helldivers to fulfill production quotas for deluxe Maelstrom Tank features. This has caused significant distress amongst the early investors who were promised these features as incentives, resulting in a precipitous drop in pre-sales and a decrease in share value. As a result, the Maelstrom Tank project is now at risk of termination.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Production of Maelstrom Tanks for civilian and military use is proceeding on schedule. Now, deluxe features offered as incentives for early investors must be fabricated. The Helldivers are ordered to dismantle 5,000,000 Automaton Tanks to repurpose their engine cooling systems as climate-controlled cupholders, and harvest 25,000,000 Chargers to convert their carapaces to vibration-insulation panels.

MAJOR ORDER WON The Helldivers liberated PHACT BAY and MARFARK. AM Defense has already broken ground on massive factories for large-scale Maelstrom Tank fabrication. Pre-orders from qualifying citizens for home defense Tanks have already sold out, evidencing the eagerness of Super Earth citizens to exercise their natural-born freedoms.
STRATEGIC ALERT The Automaton Incineration Corps has been reported on VINDEMITARIX PRIME.

MINOR TERMINID OUTBREAK A minor Terminid outbreak has occured on FRONTERIA. It is evident that some dissidents continue their hopeless effort to disrupt citizen confidence in the TCS+. The Helldivers are ordered to put down this small, low-threat outbreak.
NEW MAJOR ORDER Enemy aggression prevents the long-term construction of the new Maelstrom Tank, threatening our citizens' inherent right to self-defense. Liberate MARFARK and PHACT BAY immediately.

STRATEGIC UPDATE Miscalibrations in the Democracy Space Station have required it to be taken temporarily offline in order to be resolved. The Ministry of Defense has shifted significant personnel to these fixes, making it a top priority. Those responsible for the mistakes will attend an intensive re-training seminar. If the issue persists, their families will also attend the seminar.

CAMPAIGN FAILURE Cyborg interference has raised significant doubts in the veracity of the Quarter-Term Elections. As a result, a re-vote has been ordered, with enhanced election security measures to make interference impossible. SEAF Battalions have been recalled from the frontlines to secure voting sites.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION Funds from the Super Secure Elections Act have been allocated to support Helldiver operations on ROGUE 5 with the Anti-Personnel Mine Deployer Stratagem for the next 24 hours.

ARSENAL AUGMENTATION Funds from the Super Secure Elections Act have been allocated to support Helldiver operations on HALDUS with the Gas Mines Stratagem for the next 24 hours.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION Funds from the Super Secure Elections Act have been allocated to support Helldiver operations on BLISTICA with the Incendiary Mines Stratagem for the next 24 hours.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION Funds from the Super Secure Elections Act have been allocated to support Helldiver operations on TERREK with the Anti-Personnel Mine Deployer Stratagem for the next 24 hours.

NEW MAJOR ORDER The Super Earth Government, informed by the results of an expert election security panel, has passed a comprehensive Super Secure Elections Act, which allocates new military spending for upholding election security. Helldiver arsenals have been augmented with a number of stratagems. They are directed to uphold election security—by any means necessary.

MAJOR ORDER WON The Helldivers rapidly and violently decomissioned over 200,000,000 Automaton Troopers. Any ongoing production of imposter robot voters must now be redirected to refilling their frontline ranks. The upcoming Quarter-term elections have been protected from yet another external threat.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Evidence of an even more abhorrent Cyborg plot to manipulate the upcoming Quarter-term elections has been discovered: to create androids, disguised as Super Earth citizens, to infiltrate voting centers. The Helldivers are ordered to immediately deploy to destroy 200,000,000 Automaton Troopers, depleting their stock of potential infiltrators.

MAJOR ORDER FAILED The Helldivers recaptured CHARBAL-VII, by the Cyborgs retained hold of ZZANIAH PRIME. Massive server banks were discovered in the captured Megafactories. Cybersecurity specialists have confirmed that these server banks could be used in the conduct of cyberattacks—confirming the enemy's intent beyond doubt.
INCINERATION CORPS SIGHTED The Automaton Incineration Corps has resurfaced on VINDEMITARIX PRIME.
JET BRIGADE SIGHTED The Automaton Jet Brigade has resurfaced on AURORA BAY.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Intercepted Cyborg communications indicate an upcoming cyberattack designed to impede election Management for the upcoming Quarter-term elections. It is believed these assaults will originate from MegafactorIes on CHARBAL-VII and ZZANIAH PRIME. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate these planets immediately.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Eagle Gas Airstrike Stratagem availability has now ended.

HEETH LOST
Heeth has fallen to the Terminid Menace. We cannot allow this infestation to continue to spread.

CAMPAIGN WON TCS+ nodes are under construction on BORE ROCK and NIVEL 43 following their liberation by the Helldivers. The containment of the Terminids has never been more guaranteed. The dissident network responsible for these sabotages, which existed, has been dismantled.

HEETH UNDER ATTACK
The bugs have attacked Heeth. Rally to its defense, before they are able to permanently infest it.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION High Command has authorized fleetwide availability of the Eagle Gas Airstrike Stratagem for the next 72 hours.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Recent sabotages of the TCS+ by dissidents have threatened the populace and inflamed public outrage. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate BORE ROCK and NIVEL 43, Terminid-held planets adjacent to those sabotaged by dissidents, so that the TCS+ can be built on those planets as well. In so doing, the impregnable barrier of the TCS+ will be made twice as impregnable as before.

active_campaign.title: ARMORED EAGLE
active_campaign.label: ACTIVE CAMPAIGN
active_campaign.description: A patriotic defense contractor has agreed to fabricate personal-defense tanks for citizen use. The Helldivers are called upon to secure the resources and territory necessary to protect our citizens' right to self-defense.
active_campaign.description_cn: 一家爱国的防务承包商已同意为公民制造个人防卫坦克。绝地潜兵奉命夺取必要的资源与领土，以捍卫公民的自卫权。

phases.title: Secure Territory
phases.briefing:
The Ministry of Defense has signed a new agreement with AM Defense, the patriotic contractor responsible for the high-quality line of FRVs, to construct a new tank model: the Maelstrom Tank. In an exciting new frontier for civilian freedom, the Tank will be made available for purchase to qualifying citizens. 

Enemy aggression, however, threatens this Freedom, by denying AM Defense the territory recently allocated for Maelstrom Tank construction. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate MARFARK and PHACT BAY immediately.

AM Defense has graciously provided, free of charge, prototype Maelstrom Tank models to augment Helldiver arsenals for the liberation of this territory.
phases.briefing_cn:
国防部已与 AM Defense 签署新协议，建造一款新型坦克：TD-110 “风暴漩涡”坦克。这家爱国的承包商正是那条高质量快速侦察载具产品线的制造商。作为公民自由的全新前沿，符合条件的公民将可购买该型坦克。

然而，敌人的侵略正在威胁这份自由：他们不让 AM Defense 获得近期划拨给“风暴漩涡”坦克生产线的领土。绝地潜兵奉命立即解放玛尔法克与丈人一湾。

AM Defense 已慷慨地无偿提供“风暴漩涡”坦克原型车，用于充实绝地潜兵的军械库，以完成这片领土的解放。

phases.title: Resource Acquisition
phases.briefing:
Production of Maelstrom Tanks for civilian and military use is proceeding on schedule. Now, deluxe features offered as incentives for early investors must be fabricated. The Helldivers are ordered to dismantle 5,000,000 Automaton Tanks to repurpose their engine cooling systems as climate-controlled cupholders, and harvest 25,000,000 Chargers to convert their carapaces to vibration-insulation panels.

AM Defense has invested heavily in tank production, taking on significant debt in the process—a patriotic risk to improve the security of all citizens. Disruption to investor confidence at this critical juncture could jeopardize the project, and AM Defense itself. It is imperative the Helldivers secure these resources.
phases.briefing_cn:
用于民用和军用的风暴漩涡坦克生产正按计划进行。现在，必须制造作为早期投资者激励的豪华配置。绝地潜兵奉命拆解5,000,000辆机器人坦克，将其引擎冷却系统改作恒温杯架，并采集25,000,000只强袭虫，将其甲壳转化为隔振板。

AM Defense已大举投资坦克生产，并在此过程中承担了巨额债务——这是一项旨在提升全体平民安全的爱国风险。在这一关键时刻动摇投资者信心，可能危及该项目以及AM Defense本身。绝地潜兵必须确保这些资源。

major_order.title: MAJOR ORDER
major_order.brief: Kill the requisite enemies to ensure early investors in the TD-110 Maelstrom Tanks receive their promised deluxe features.
major_order.translated_brief: 消灭指定数量的敌人，确保“风暴漩涡”坦克的早期投资者获得承诺的豪华配置。
